fix: Use as written, with these guards: run in git bash with MSYS_NO_PATHCONV=1 (without it the /kaggle/input manifest path gets mangled); keep the --set order exactly (order changes the sha, as the exp70g case shows); before any exp83* read, add (r"exp83[a-z]*", "safetail_ci") ahead of the exp8\d rule or pass --family <ref>=safetail_ci; push the CI-stack dummies early because of the queue; log nb sha + metadata sha in CONTEXT at push.
realistic_gain: No score gain in itself. It removes build-time errors and wrong-stack risk for the W2/W3 rows (a wrong --set order or path conversion would give a different, untested notebook). Saves ~10-20 min of main-session time per build.
